text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...!? W-What on earth was that just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...How strange. It feels as though I've 
been enveloped in a gentle warmth..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to run so badly... Strength is 
welling up inside me...!
